name: NLA Strip
description: A container referencing an existing Action

props.name: Type
props.description: Type of NLA Strip

items.name: Meta
items.description: NLA Strip acts as a container for adjacent strips

items.name: Sound Clip
items.description: NLA Strip representing a sound event for speakers

props.name: Extrapolation
props.description: Action to take for gaps past the strip extents

items.name: Nothing
items.description: Strip has no influence past its extents

items.name: Hold
items.description: Hold the first frame if no previous strips in track, and always hold last frame

props.name: Blending
props.description: Method used for combining strip's result with accumulated result

items.name: Replace
items.description: The strip values replace the accumulated results by amount specified by influence

items.name: Combine
items.description: The strip values are combined with accumulated results by appropriately using addition, multiplication, or quaternion math, based on channel type

items.name: Add
items.description: Weighted result of strip is added to the accumulated results

items.name: Subtract
items.description: Weighted result of strip is removed from the accumulated results

items.name: Multiply
items.description: Weighted result of strip is multiplied with the accumulated results

props.name: Start Frame (raw value)
props.description: Same as frame_start, except that any value can be set, including ones that create an invalid state

props.name: End Frame (raw value)
props.description: Same as frame_end, except that any value can be set, including ones that create an invalid state

props.name: Start Frame (manipulated from UI)
props.description: Start frame of the NLA strip. Note: changing this value also updates the value of the strip's end frame. If only the start frame should be changed, see the "frame_start" property instead.

props.name: End Frame (manipulated from UI)
props.description: End frame of the NLA strip. Note: changing this value also updates the value of the strip's repeats or its action's end frame. If only the end frame should be changed, see the "frame_end" property instead.

props.name: Blend In
props.description: Number of frames at start of strip to fade in influence

props.name: Auto Blend In/Out
props.description: Number of frames for Blending In/Out is automatically determined from overlapping strips

props.name: Action
props.description: Action referenced by this strip

props.name: Action Slot Handle
props.description: A number that identifies which sub-set of the Action is considered to be for this NLA strip

props.name: Last Action Slot Identifier
props.description: The identifier of the most recently assigned action slot. The slot identifies which sub-set of the Action is considered to be for this strip, and its identifier is used to find the right slot when assigning an Action.

props.name: Action Slot
props.description: The slot identifies which sub-set of the Action is considered to be for this strip, and its name is used to find the right slot when assigning another Action

props.name: Action Slots
props.description: The list of action slots suitable for this NLA strip

props.name: Action Start Frame
props.description: First frame from action to use

props.name: Action End Frame
props.description: Last frame from action to use

props.name: Repeat
props.description: Number of times to repeat the action range

props.name: Scale
props.description: Scaling factor for action

props.name: F-Curves
props.description: F-Curves for controlling the strip's influence and timing

props.name: Modifiers
props.description: Modifiers affecting all the F-Curves in the referenced Action

props.name: NLA Strips
props.description: NLA Strips that this strip acts as a container for (if it is of type Meta)

props.name: Influence
props.description: Amount the strip contributes to the current result

props.name: Strip Time
props.description: Frame of referenced Action to evaluate

props.name: Animated Influence
props.description: Influence setting is controlled by an F-Curve rather than automatically determined

props.name: Animated Strip Time
props.description: Strip time is controlled by an F-Curve rather than automatically determined

props.name: Cyclic Strip Time
props.description: Cycle the animated time within the action start and end

props.name: Active
props.description: NLA Strip is active

props.name: Select
props.description: NLA Strip is selected

props.name: Mute
props.description: Disable NLA Strip evaluation

props.name: Reversed
props.description: NLA Strip is played back in reverse order (only when timing is automatically determined)

props.name: Sync Action Length
props.description: Update range of frames referenced from action after tweaking strip and its keyframes
